name: drupal/adminlte
description: Official AdminLTE 4 application theme for Drupal — dashboards, intranets and SaaS UIs. Bootstrap 5.3, vanilla JS, light & dark modes; also works as an admin theme.

suggest.drupal/css_editor: Add custom CSS from the admin UI without touching theme files.
suggest.drupal/ui_patterns: Surfaces the theme's SDC components (small box, info box, callout) in Layout Builder, Views and field formatters.
suggest.drupal/gin_login: Beautiful alternative to the default AdminLTE login screen.
